Class InvitationRepository

java.lang.Object
Database.Repositories.InvitationRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
Database.Repositories.Interfaces.IInvitationRepository
public class InvitationRepository extends Object implements Database.Repositories.Interfaces.IInvitationRepository
The InvitationRepository class provides database operations for Invitation objects. It implements methods to create, read, update, and print invitation codes.
